composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyLimit

checkDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentity

# Household duplicate-detection step: the householdId is derived deterministically from
# (lastName, postcode), so a second owner sharing both is the same household and is
# rejected with 409 unless the request opts in via sharesHousehold (a declared member).
# Runs after the household id is assigned and before save so a duplicate is a 409 rather
# than a persisted record.
checkIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Soft-match: after checkIdentity has rejected/admitted the household duplicate, flag a new
# owner that shares an existing owner's lastName + postcode with a different telephone. A
# declared household member (sharesHousehold) is never flagged. Runs before save so the
# flags are computed against pre-existing owners and persisted with this one.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri

          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string

          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail

          type: string

          readOnly: true
        timestamp:

      required:

    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object

        message:

          readOnly: true
      required:

      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility, and also returned as the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g.
            unit or apartment). Stored and returned normalized when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored) and stored
            and returned in E.164 form: a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits. A national
            number with no country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading
            '0' dropped, so '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. The householdId is derived deterministically from the
            owner's last name and postcode, so owners sharing both are the same
            household. When true, the create request is admitted as a declared member
            of that household (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate); otherwise
            a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                single space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. the stored
                '+61412345678' displays as '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalized last name + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last
                name and postcode always share it. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
                Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0;
                add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a
                household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure over 365 days. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the customerCode (the
                region-and-hash identity, derived from the postcode). 'UNKNOWN' when no
                region could be derived. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at the moment of registration, derived from birthDate
                measured against registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId are empty
                when absent). A create is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing
                owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one softly matches (same lastName and
                postcode, different telephone) when possibleDuplicate is true; null
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional. When present it drives the
            derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility, and also returned as the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g.
            unit or apartment). Stored and returned normalized when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored) and stored
            and returned in E.164 form: a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits. A national
            number with no country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading
            '0' dropped, so '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. The householdId is derived deterministically from the
            owner's last name and postcode, so owners sharing both are the same
            household. When true, the create request is admitted as a declared member
            of that household (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate); otherwise
            a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                single space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. the stored
                '+61412345678' displays as '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalized last name + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last
                name and postcode always share it. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
                Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0;
                add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a
                household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure over 365 days. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true

## Change: `salutation` derived field

The spec: a create request may include `title` (MR/MRS/MS/DR); the owner's `salutation` is `title + " " + lastName`, or just `lastName` when no title is given. Since the acceptance test reads `salutation` back via `GET /api/owners/{id}`, `title` must be persisted and `salutation` derived on read.

Following the project's OfficeFloor/derived-field conventions:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added `title` (enum MR/MRS/MS/DR) to the `OwnerFields` schema (an input field) and `salutation` (read-only, derived) to the `Owner` schema. The DTOs are generated from this file.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added a persisted `title` column with getter/setter, so the title survives to GET time. `salutation` is not stored; it's derived.

3. **`Salutation.java`** (new model helper) — mirrors the existing `Locality`/`ContactPreference` pattern: `Salutation.of(owner)` returns `title + " " + lastName`, or `lastName` when the title is null/empty.

4. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added `@Mapping(target = "salutation", expression = "java(...Salutation.of(owner))")`, alongside the other derived-field mappings. MapStruct maps the `title` enum ⇄ entity `String` automatically.

5. **DB schemas** (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres) — added the `title` column to the `owners` table. Tests run on hsqldb.

No `@RestController` or Spring MVC was introduced; the existing POST/GET pipelines already flow the entity through `BuildOwner` (mapper writes `title`) and `RespondWithOwner`/`RespondWithOwnerCreated` (mapper derives `salutation`), so no YAML changes were needed.
